NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshot added, but the PR still doesn't link an issue or say how it was tested**

New: The author posted a before/after dark mode screenshot, which answers the screenshot feedback. There is no new push. Missing: a "Fixes: #N" line (open issue #38931 looks like the match, so check it has "help wanted"), and a description of how the change was actually tested in the browser, including the new right-side arrow rule, which the screenshot doesn't show.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link the issue and describe their manual testing; no reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshot! Please add a "Fixes: #N" line for the issue this addresses (it looks like #38931), and update the "How changes were tested" section to say how you checked the result in the browser, including the right-side arrow placement. The [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) covers both.
```
